newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB wins $250 mln US nuclear deal.
newsitem.headline: ABB wins $250 mln US nuclear deal.

text.p: Electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said it had signed a contract valued at more than $250 million to supply nuclear fuel and related services to the Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station, near Phoenix, Arizona.
ABB said in a statement that the contract was signed with the Arizona Public Service Co.
The order extends ABB's current fuel supply contract with Arizona Public Service by a further 20 years to year 2016.

The nuclear fuel assemplies will be fabricated in ABB's nuclear fuel production facilities in the U.S. and the first fuel batches produced under the agreement will be delivered to the power plant in August 1997.
ABB has been the sole supplier to Palo Verde's three 1,270 megawatt pressurized water reactors (PWR), which were originally supplied by Combustion Engineering, which ABB acquired in 1988.

The award is the fourth major nuclear fuel contract that ABB has received this year for PWR plants. The earlier orders were from Florida Power & Light Co., Baltimore Gas & Electric Co. and from Korea Electric Power Corp.
